outcome: Duration of exclusive breastfeeding (4 and 6 months)
finding: Women who delivered by cesarean section had lower odds of initiating and maintaining exclusive breastfeeding, and this association was influenced by factors such as pre-pregnancy BMI, age, education level, and income.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with lower odds of initiating exclusive breastfeeding and continuing it for four and six months compared to vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Categorical birth weight data was collected
